document.text: Dr. Chen has one vial of antivenom. Imani needs the antivenom. Pavel needs the antivenom. Dr. Chen can administer the antivenom to either Imani or Pavel, but not both. If Dr. Chen administers the antivenom to Imani, Imani will recover. If Dr. Chen administers the antivenom to Pavel, Pavel will recover.
